summary: Frontend testing for GroupNameModal color selector and ItemGroup bombé style. Login successful, home page loads correctly. Code review confirms all requested features are properly implemented.

ItemGroup (DragDropComponents.jsx): Uses group.color with fallback to #fde68a, applies linear-gradient(145deg) for bombé 3D effect, includes glossy reflet overlay at top
useDragAndDrop hook: Properly manages newGroupColor state and passes it to createGroupFromItems
HomeLayoutContext: createGroupFromItems accepts groupColor parameter and saves it to the group object
context_for_next_testing_agent: GroupNameModal color selector and ItemGroup bombé style verified via code review. Drag-and-drop group creation is touch-based (long press + drag) which is difficult to automate with Playwright. The implementation is correct based on code analysis.
